neighbours.label: the rule or pattern that something is done according to: the noun/article after 'according to', 'after the fashion of', 按/따라 ("according to the pattern")
fire: The denominators are computed according to the pattern given in the formula.
The militia shall be trained according to the discipline prescribed by Congress.
He wore the amulet under his robe, after the fashion of the country.
The entries are arranged according to a fixed order to help the reader.
They settled the dispute according to the custom of their ancestors.
Each tile was cut according to the template supplied by the architect.
Students bought the books according to the list their teacher had printed.
The ceremony was performed in accordance with the rites of the old church.
quiet: The denominators are computed quickly before the formula is printed.
The militia shall be trained near the river before the winter.
He wore the amulet under his robe during the long journey.
The entries are arranged on the shelf to help the reader.
They settled the dispute after a long meeting in the village.
Each tile was cut by hand in the workshop of the architect.
Students bought the books at the shop their teacher had mentioned.
The ceremony was performed in the courtyard of the old church.
